final: WITH g AS (SELECT o.timespan AS ts, AVG(f.rebrate * 1.0 / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS r, COUNT(*) AS c FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), a AS (SELECT AVG(c * 1.0) AS ac FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.r) AS avg_of_avg_ratio, SUM(g.c) AS total_matches, AVG(g.c - a.ac) AS avg_excess FROM g, a WHERE g.c > a.ac
